segments.text: The operator slides the folded white weighing paper into the balance's glass enclosure with both hands and lays it flat on the circular metal weighing pan, then withdraws both hands; the balance reading rises from zero to a small nonzero value.

segments.text: The operator holds the opened small amber glass bottle in the left hand and, with a bright green plastic spatula/spoon in the right hand, repeatedly scoops white powder from the bottle mouth, reaches into the balance's glass enclosure, and adds the powder onto the weighing paper on the weighing pan; the balance reading rises gradually from zero and then jumps to a larger value, with repeated fine adjustments of the added amount in between.

segments.label: Set column separation parameters
segments.text: The operator continuously sets up a column chromatography separation task on the tablet atop the flash chromatography system (SepaBean machine, SPBT-00271): the interface moves from the task list through the 'normal-phase separation / reversed-phase separation' selection page and the target-compound information page into the normal-phase separation parameter page, where the operator enters the flow rate (80 mL/min), wavelength 1 (collection, 254 nm), wavelength 2 (detection, 280 nm), and starting rack (rack 1) / starting tube (1). Along the way a Silica column selection list appears on the screen, the page shows fields such as collection volume and time-based collection (10 mL), and the numeric keypad is brought up repeatedly to enter values (200 appears in an input box). At the end, the hand moves from the tablet toward the machine's blue touchscreen.

segments.label: Arrange receiving tubes
segments.text: The operator grasps a black test tube rack holding numbered glass tubes with both hands and pushes it horizontally from the benchtop into the sample slot at the front of the column chromatography machine; the rack gradually disappears into the machine with its front handle and numbered panel remaining outside, while both hands keep holding the handle.

segments.label: Set column separation parameters
segments.text: The operator places both hands on either side of the tablet on top of the column chromatography machine; the screen first shows the normal-phase separation parameters page (total sample 10 mg, column SW-5101-330, wavelength 1 collection 254 nm, wavelength 2 detection 280 nm, full range 200-800, UV threshold 200 mAU, collection volume 10 ml, starting tube rack Tube Rack 1, time-based collection, background subtraction), and at about 130 s switches to the binary gradient curve page (start/end values such as Begin 3.0/End 11.2, FlowRate 80.0, a rising gradient curve), with page advances and scrolling indicating that setup is in progress. At the end of the segment (from about 135 s), both hands leave the tablet and the right hand reaches toward the small blue-capped bottle lying horizontally on the bench and the white column cartridge; in all visible frames, the workflow menus 'purge lines / install column / adjust column / add sample' never appear.

segments.label: Install sample column
segments.text: The operator picks up with both hands the white column tube that has a small amount of white powder on its top from the bench, first moves it horizontally toward the top port of the chromatography machine, then guides it downward so it stands vertically into the machine's column position and docks with the transparent tubing above; the operator then releases both hands, leaving the column standing upright on its own in the column position.

segments.label: Wet and equilibrate column
segments.text: The column chromatography machine enters the 'column adjusting' running state: UV1/UV2 readings and a stop button appear on the tablet interface, the machine's lower screen shows a bar graph and starts timing, and the operator holds the controller with both hands hovering in front of the screen, watching.

segments.label: Other visible lab operation
segments.text: The view cuts back to a top-down shot of the white benchtop (a blue tip box, a test tube rack, and a reagent bottle are visible). The operator brings the right hand close to a dark cylindrical object on the bench, then both hands pick up a small semi-transparent plastic part and hold it.

segments.label: Other visible lab operation
segments.text: The operator holds a small bottle with a blue screw cap containing a small amount of clear liquid in both hands, first unscrews the cap and sets it on the benchtop while holding the bottle tilted, then retrieves the cap and screws it back onto the bottle mouth.

segments.label: Other visible lab operation
segments.text: The operator first clasps a small blue-capped vial with both hands and twists it, then switches the left hand to an upright frosted semi-transparent cylindrical container, and finally clasps a white semi-transparent squeeze bottle with both hands; the background is now the instrument area with a chromatography column and test tube rack.

segments.label: Other visible lab operation
segments.text: The operator first grips a white squeeze bottle with both hands and squeezes it, the bottle body deforming under pressure; the left hand then lifts the squeeze bottle while the right hand detaches the transparent tube end with a brass fitting from the brass connector at the top of the column and moves it to a lower position to hold it, while at the same time the left hand inverts the squeeze bottle and fits it onto the column-top connector. At the end of the segment, the inverted squeeze bottle sits stably on top of the column with the left hand supporting the bottle body, and the transparent tube end is held up at the upper right by the right hand.

segments.label: Other visible lab operation
segments.text: With the right hand the operator pushes a slender tube-like tool with a beige tip into the mouth of the white translucent squeeze bottle held in the left hand, then inverts the white bottle and, docked via the tool, places it onto the top port of the chromatography machine's black cylindrical module, and then moves it to hang on the upper right of the machine. The tablet interface above switches from a dialog page with "Done" and "Previous step" to the "Add Sample" page, then into a function menu with icons such as "Solvent", "Solid phase", "Add Sample", "Flush lines" and "Adjust column"; the operator's finger reaches near the "Add Sample" area of the screen, then both hands rise and hover in front of the screen without touching it.

segments.label: Other visible lab operation
segments.text: The column machine keeps running at rest with the screen showing initialization complete / running; the camera turns toward the floor, capturing the white lab coat, blue shoe covers and cables, and finally returns to the view of the bench where the instrument sits at rest; the video ends.
